card.summary: 10 MiB total per paste, 5 MiB per file. Anonymous pastes expire after 7 days; signed-in pastes can be permanent. Built on Cloudflare Workers.

free_tier.stated: 10 MiB total per paste, 5 MiB per file. Anonymous pastes expire after 7 days; signed-in pastes can be permanent. Built on Cloudflare Workers.

retention.stated: Anonymous pastes expire after 7 days; signed-in pastes can be permanent

egress.terms: Free outbound transfer served from Cloudflare Workers edge nodes with cacheable responses and no egress billing.

record.tooling: https://api.paste.gg/v1/pastes, JSON body {name, files:[{name, content:{format:'text', value}}]}; no key needed for anonymous, returns a deletion key. API keys available at Settings -> API keys.
record.chaining: Unlimited anonymous pastes x up to 10 MiB, but 7-day anonymous expiry makes it a hot/cache tier only. With free accounts: permanent pastes x unlimited per account. That is the only archive-shaped path.
record.limits_note: 10 MiB total / 5 MiB per file; 7-day expiry anonymous; visibility public or unlisted when anonymous.
record.reliability_note: CF Workers edge means fast global reads and no egress bill. Anonymous content is dropped at 7 days by design; signed-in is required for anything you want to keep.

evidence.proved: 'All pastes: up to 10 MiB total and 5 MiB per file', 'Anonymous: public or unlisted, with expiration after 7 days'

record.notes: 10 MiB total per paste, 5 MiB per file. Anonymous pastes expire after 7 days; signed-in pastes can be permanent. Built on Cloudflare Workers.

extras.unit_note: free_tier.unit is 'mixed' because the headline is denominated in MiB or KiB, which the schema enum does not carry; the verbatim free_tier.stated keeps the true unit.
